views.def:
SELECT l.id,
    l.title,
    l.type,
    l.price,
    l.region,
    l.area,
    l.created_at,
    v.venture_name,
    v.is_verified,
    cover.storage_path AS cover_path,
    rt.rating,
    rt.review_count,
    l.bedrooms
   FROM (((listings l
     JOIN ventures v ON ((v.id = l.venture_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.storage_path
           FROM (listing_media lm
             JOIN media m ON ((m.id = lm.media_id)))
          WHERE ((lm.listing_id = l.id) AND lm.is_cover)
         LIMIT 1) cover ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT round(avg(r.rating), 1) AS rating,
            (count(*))::integer AS review_count
           FROM reviews r
          WHERE (r.listing_id = l.id)) rt ON (true))
  WHERE l.is_active;
views.name: listing_cards

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, avatar_url)
  values (new.id, new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url');
  return new;
end;
$function$
functions.name: handle_new_user

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_place_name(s text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  select trim(regexp_replace(
           regexp_replace(lower(unaccent(coalesce(s, ''))), '[''’]', '', 'g'),
           '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'));
$function$
functions.name: normalize_place_name

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_places(q text, p_country text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_kinds text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], lim integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, name text, admin1 text, kind text, country_code text, lat double precision, lng double precision, population integer, score real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  with query as (select normalize_place_name(q) as t)
  select p.id, p.name, p.admin1, p.kind, p.country_code,
         st_y(p.location::geometry), st_x(p.location::geometry), p.population,
         max(similarity(n.name_search, query.t)
             + case when n.name_search like query.t || '%' then 1 else 0 end)::real as score
  from query
  join place_names n on length(query.t) >= 2
                    and (n.name_search like query.t || '%' or n.name_search % query.t)
  join places p on p.id = n.place_id
  where p.status = 'approved'
    and (p_country is null or p.country_code = upper(p_country))
    and (p_kinds   is null or p.kind = any (p_kinds))
  group by p.id
  order by score desc, p.population desc nulls last, p.name
  limit least(lim, 20);
$function$
functions.name: search_places

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_refresh_verification_from_auth()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.refresh_venture_verification(new.id);
  return new;
end $function$
functions.name: trg_refresh_verification_from_auth

end $function$
